newsitem.title: USA: Natgas futures end lower, reluctant to break out.
newsitem.headline: Natgas futures end lower, reluctant to break out.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures settled lower Wednesday, but January indicated some reluctance to break out of the $4.05 area, sources said.

January finished 9.5 cents lower at $4.075 per million British thermal units after dipping to a low of $3.90 earlier in the session. February settled down 2.7 cents at $3.586, narrowing the margin to Jan to 48.9 cents.
Traders said support in January was at $3.87, then $3.80. Resistance was seen in the low-$4.30s, then in the $4.56-4.60 area. The contract high is $4.60.
